name: Palo / Palo Steakhouse Center-Cut Beef Tenderloin, Prime Striploin & Japanese A5 Wagyu
brandOrRestaurant: Disney Wonder & Magic · Palo / Disney Treasure · Palo Steakhouse (Dinner)
whyItWorks: The 6 oz or 8 oz Center-Cut Beef Tenderloin Filet is ultra-lean, buttery-tender, and zero-fiber; A5 Wagyu is melt-in-your-mouth in small 2–3 oz tasting portions.
prepOrOrderInstructions: During a flare or everyday dining, order the Center-Cut Beef Tenderloin Filet (medium-rare, salt only, Barolo/Gorgonzola sauce on the side) with Truffle-Free Mashed Potatoes or Cavatelli.
watchOuts: Japanese A5 Wagyu has very high intramuscular fat (keep to a small tasting portion if fat-sensitive)
Order rich sauces on the side
